name: devops-lsp
description: A DevOps marketplace of Claude Code language-server plugins. Add it once and use the same TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, shell, PHP, JSON, and YAML support in every project.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence, plus auto-heal: eslint --fix after edits and a tsc --noEmit check script.

plugins.name: rust-lsp
plugins.description: Rust code intelligence, plus auto-heal: rustfmt after edits and a cargo clippy check script.

plugins.name: python-lsp
plugins.description: Python code intelligence, plus auto-heal: ruff check --fix and ruff format after edits and a basedpyright check script.

plugins.name: shell-lsp
plugins.description: Shell script code intelligence, plus auto-heal: shellcheck fixes and shfmt after edits, plus a shellcheck check script.

plugins.name: php-lsp
plugins.description: PHP code intelligence, plus auto-heal: php -l and the project's formatter after edits and a PHPStan check script.

plugins.name: json-lsp
plugins.description: JSON and JSONC code intelligence, plus auto-heal: Prettier after edits and a prettier --check script.

plugins.name: yaml-lsp
plugins.description: YAML code intelligence, plus auto-heal: Prettier after edits and a yamllint check script.
